Comprehensive civil law services

The Circosta Law Firm provides comprehensive services in civil law, offering legal assistance in disputes that affect daily life, private relationships and business activities.

We represent clients in litigation concerning:

  • contracts;
  • property;
  • family matters;
  • inheritance;
  • civil liability.

In every case we ensure strong advocacy and tailored strategies.

Judicial representation

Our strength lies in judicial representation: we defend the interests of individuals and companies before civil courts, managing proceedings with professionalism and precision.

We also support clients in negotiations and alternative dispute resolution, aiming to resolve conflicts quickly and efficiently while safeguarding their rights.

Cross-border disputes

With an international outlook, we ensure that cross-border civil cases are handled with expertise, combining local legal knowledge with international standards.
